description: This file defines constants, regex caching functions, and utility functions for handling silent reply tokens, including detection, stripping, and prefix matching, used in an auto-reply system.

methods.name: getSilentExactRegex
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a cached regex to match the exact silent reply token with optional whitespace.

methods.name: getSilentTrailingRegex
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a cached regex to match trailing silent reply tokens in text.

methods.name: isSilentReplyText
methods.description: Checks if the given text exactly matches the silent reply token, considering optional whitespace.

methods.name: isSilentReplyEnvelopeText
methods.description: Checks if the text is a JSON envelope containing an action field with the silent reply token.

methods.name: isSilentReplyPayloadText
methods.description: Checks if the text is either a silent reply text or envelope.

methods.name: stripSilentToken
methods.description: Removes trailing silent reply tokens from text.

methods.name: isSilentReplyPrefixText
methods.description: Checks if the text starts with a silent reply prefix, considering uppercase and underscore rules.
